_doc: 3-man Nythraxis ATTUNEMENT questline. pala1/Pontius (ret paladin, leader) + sham2/Shims (enh shaman) + ryze5/ryzemage (mage). The brain's attune mode (combat.attune) walks them through the q_nythraxis_* chain: (1) loot 10 runed_bone_shard from Boneclad Revenants ~(-40,830), (2) interact 3 grave objects, (3) the Abandoned Crypt instance (relics -> elites -> keystones), (4) the ritual circle + Bound Guardian. Accept/turn in together at Brother Aldric (-10,656). Completing 1-4 = ATTUNED (Scourge's End in hand). Quest 5 is a 10-player raid kill, out of scope. Run: node scripts/multibox.mjs scripts/multibox.attune.json
